clue.text: Guaranteed this sort of land in Canaan

definitions.meaning: pledged or assured, as of something sworn to happen

definitions.text: this sort of land in Canaan
definitions.meaning: Canaan is the land God pledged to Abraham's descendants in the Bible

explanation.definitionFit: Something guaranteed has been pledged, and Canaan is the Bible's Promised Land, pledged to the Israelites.

clue.text: South American girl will bear scrutiny

parts.note: Peru is a South American country
Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally or Sarah

explanation.surface: A Latin American woman can stand up to close examination.
explanation.definitionFit: A perusal is a careful reading or inspection.

clue.text: Vigilant lackey props up old boy

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that props up another sits below it

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
a lackey is a servant

explanation.surface: A watchful footman supports an elderly former pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: An observant person is alert and quick to notice things.

clue.text: One small measure seen perhaps to become large

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
mm is a millimetre, a small measure of length

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the word could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A tiny amount, once seen, might grow huge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small measure' is the millimetre, abbreviated mm, and 'perhaps' rearranges SEEN into ENSE; 'to become' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Immense means vast or huge.

clue.text: Ben's broken up 'about the man he buries

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the man
broken up means the letters are smashed and reassembled

parts.note: the possessive s counts as a letter here
Tom is any man, as in Tom, Dick and Harry

explanation.surface: Ben is distraught over the man he lays to rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' stands for any man; 'broken up' gives ENBS from the letters of Ben's, and 'about' wraps that round the man.
explanation.definitionFit: To entomb is to place in a tomb, to inter.

clue.text: Exhibitionist in model city

parts.note: to model is to sit or stand for an artist, to pose
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city, a crossword regular

explanation.surface: A show-off living in a city of fashion models.
explanation.definitionFit: A poseur is someone who puts on airs to impress, an affected show-off.

clue.text: Regret giving cheap present; say

indicators.note: say means the words are spoken and the sound gives the answer

parts.note: penny for cheap and tense for the grammatical present together

explanation.surface: Someone feels sorry for giving an inexpensive gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' is the grammatical present tense, not a gift; 'cheap' gives PENNY.
explanation.definitionFit: Penitence is sorrow or remorse for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Top man to drink with military and medical men

parts.note: to sup is to drink
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
MO is a medical officer

explanation.surface: The boss goes for a drink with army officers and doctors.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is an overall leader or boss.

clue.text: Use lint to make strange device

indicators.note: strange means the letters are made odd by rearranging

explanation.surface: Fluff turned to some peculiar purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: A utensil is a tool or implement, especially in a kitchen.

clue.text: Problem in, school about one starting again

indicators.note: the problem word sits inside the rest of the wordplay
about means the school's name goes round the letter for one

parts.note: Repton is an English public school in Derbyshire
I is the Roman numeral one
a sum is an arithmetic problem set in class

explanation.surface: A school difficulty that has a pupil beginning over again.
explanation.walkthrough: Repton is a boarding school in Derbyshire; 'about' puts the one inside to give REPTION, and the problem goes 'in' that.
explanation.definitionFit: A resumption is a taking up again after a pause, a restart.

clue.text: Mixed-up, 'sanctimonious man

parts.note: pi is slang for pious or sanctimonious
Ed is a man's name, short for Edward

explanation.surface: A confused man who is also smugly pious.
explanation.walkthrough: Printers call jumbled type 'pied', which is the sense here.
explanation.definitionFit: Printers' type that has been jumbled up is said to be pied.

clue.text: Support for sleeper is bound to tangle hair

parts.note: to bound is to leap or spring
a mat is a tangled mass, as of hair
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone tossing in bed is sure to get their hair in a knot.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprung bed base is what a sleeper lies on, supporting the body overnight.

clue.text: Swimmer's'. disheartened so. won't be among these

indicators.note: losing its heart means the central letter is taken out of the word

parts.note: Leander in Greek myth swam the Hellespont each night to reach Hero

explanation.surface: A dispirited swimmer will not finish near the front of the race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' removes N, the heart of LEANDERS. The definition leans on the surface: a dispirited swimmer won't be at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Those at the front of a race are its frontrunners, the group a dispirited competitor won't make.

clue.text: Described as an eye-opener the number in debt

indicators.note: in means these pieces go inside the debt word

parts.note: being in the red means being in debt
the opener of eye is its first letter
a count is a number, a total

explanation.surface: A revelation is told: the size of the debt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eye-opener' looks like a revelation but means the letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount is to narrate or tell, as a story.

clue.text: Confer title on Count, first in French

indicators.note: first means the French word for in is placed at the front of the charade

parts.note: en is French for in
a count is a nobleman

explanation.surface: Raising a count to the peerage, starting in France.
explanation.definitionFit: To ennoble is to make someone a peer, raising them to aristocratic rank.

clue.text: The Firebird as seen in Chesapeake Bay

definitions.meaning: the bright orange North American oriole named after a Maryland lord, nicknamed firebird
a Maryland port city on that bay

explanation.definitionFit: The orange oriole of North America is nicknamed firebird, and the Maryland port city lies on Chesapeake Bay.

clue.text: Songbirds, one of which conducts other creatures

indicators.note: to conduct is to lead, so the first piece goes in front of the second

parts.note: a tit is one kind of songbird
mice are other small animals

explanation.surface: A singing bird that acts as conductor for an orchestra of animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Titmice are small woodland songbirds, the family of blue tits and chickadees.

clue.text: Place where a horse might be

definitions.meaning: to place is to put in position or set up
a horse is often found inside its stall in the stable

explanation.definitionFit: To install is to set something in position, and a horse is found in its stall.

clue.text: Fashions hollow toy with. simplicity

parts.note: modes are fashions or styles

indicators.note: hollow means the inside of the word is removed, leaving its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A toy that is fashionably empty and plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Modesty here means plainness, a lack of showiness.

clue.text: Decided to decline decoration if the Spanish renegade is included

parts.note: the sun sets as it declines in the sky

indicators.note: is included means the reversed article goes inside the decoration's letters

parts.note: TD is the Territorial Decoration, a British military award

indicators.note: a renegade reneges or turns back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Someone refuses an award because a Spanish traitor is on the list.
explanation.walkthrough: TD, the Territorial Decoration, is a British reserve-forces award; 'renegade' gives LE, set 'is included' in TD to make TLED.
explanation.definitionFit: A settled matter is one resolved, fixed or determined.

clue.text: Well-versed man who became a gypsy

definitions.text: Well-versed man who became a gypsy

parts.words: Well-versed man who became a gypsy
parts.note: Matthew Arnold's poem about an Oxford student who left to join the gypsies, with 'well-versed' punning on poetry

explanation.walkthrough: Arnold's poem 'The ... Gipsy' tells of a poor Oxford student who went off with the travellers.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnold's poem title names the learned Oxford man who joined travelling people.

clue.text: Squashed like grapes?

parts.note: grapes are traditionally crushed underfoot in a vat to make wine

explanation.definitionFit: Walked on, flattened by feet as grapes are in winemaking.

clue.text: Most cunning river nuisance

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales
a pest is a nuisance

explanation.surface: The craftiest annoyance on the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep can mean crafty or sly, so the superlative is the most cunning.

clue.text: His cruel doom I'd mistaken for Lot's wife's

definitions.note: possessive: what Lot's wife was made of after she looked back

indicators.note: mistaken signals the letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Lot sees his wife's grim fate wrongly read as his own.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Lot's wife looked back at Sodom and was turned into a pillar of salt.
explanation.definitionFit: Lot's wife became a pillar of salt, the chemical name for common table salt.

clue.text: Mad creatures

definitions.meaning: batty, crazy, as in having ... in the belfry
flying mammals that roost upside down

explanation.definitionFit: Slang 'bats' means crazy, and bats are also the nocturnal flying mammals.

clue.text: A bottle he'd cracked with this food

indicators.note: cracked means the words are broken open and their letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A man opens a bottle of wine to go with a set meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed-price set menu served in a restaurant, the French phrase meaning the host's table.

clue.text: Competed with journalist following sport

indicators.note: following means the journalist piece comes after the sport piece

parts.note: sport means fun or play
ED is short for editor, the crossword's stock journalist

explanation.surface: Taking part in a game alongside a reporter who follows the sport.
explanation.definitionFit: To have played a match or game is to have taken part in it, contested it.

clue.text: Wing causes damage in sprat net

indicators.note: damage done to the words means their letters are wrecked and reordered

explanation.surface: A bird's wing tears a fisherman's net for sprats.
explanation.definitionFit: A transept is either arm of a cross-shaped church, projecting like a wing from the nave.
